visualCharacteristics.purpose: Narrow title column (optional icon above, optional stat tile below) beside wide body copy

contentPattern.summary: Side-by-side layout: narrow title column (with stat tile) beside body copy; cannot be expressed as default content
contentPattern.structure: each row = [optional icon image, heading (H2), optional stat tile: strong value paragraph + caption paragraph (link either to link the whole tile) | body paragraphs, images, buttons]

blockContent.notes: section-3: 2 cells [H2 + stat tile as paragraphs: linked strong "60-70%" value, caption paragraph | H3 + three paragraphs]; stat value stays out of headings. section-6: 3 cells [H2 | icon link list | Email/Media enquiries H3 + mailto links]

occurrences.description: Two columns: [H2 "Priority Driven Program" + stat tile: value "60-70%" (strong paragraph, NOT a heading) and caption "of Dementia patients are diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease", linked to https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/dementia] | [H3 "Alzheimer's and Dementia Program" + three paragraphs with inline profile links]
H2 "Community Outreach and Engagement" | two paragraphs (Breaking Good, Alice Motion links) + photo
Two columns: [H2 "Developing researcher potential"] | [two paragraphs: professional development and industry advice; annual and ongoing events]
Icon (microscope.svg), H2 "1. Fundamental research" | one paragraph (diseases studied across immunology, biology, biochemistry)
Icon (laboratory-cell.svg), H2 "2. Target Identification" | one paragraph (pinpoint the biological process)
Icon (testtubes-multiple-lab.svg), H2 "3. Hit Generation" | three paragraphs (screening hits; screening platforms; cell-based assays and most potent lead)
Icon (molecule-structure.svg), H2 "4. Lead Optimisation" | one paragraph (lead compounds optimised)
Icon (testtube-tick-check.svg), H2 "5. Clinical and pre-clinical trials" | one paragraph (preclinical and clinical studies) and button "Our partnerships" linking to /drug-discovery/partnerships

reuseGuidance: Use when a heading sits beside its body copy. Consecutive instances (or rows) are separated by a thin grey rule, so author one instance per step. Keep stat values as strong paragraphs, not headings.
usageDescription: Two-column 30/60 text layout with the section heading on the left; also numbered process steps with an orange line icon, and a key statistic tile under the heading.
